g.text: STIS database · conceptual model (full system, PostgreSQL)
Business entities and their relationships, with the table that stores each one. The AS03 assessment build uses a separate SQLite design and is not shown here.

g.text: owned by (guest trips have no owner)
A tourism record is never deleted:
withdrawal clears its published version, so
trips keep the stop and show it as
Deleting an account removes its sessions,
recovery codes and owned trips; history
keeps the change without the author.
